evidence: Applied quality-checks.md check 2: 'Verify: sentence variety, contractions, the occasional terse fragment' / 'Defect: uniform cadence, marketing gloss (seamless, robust, delve), perfectly parallel bullets, or a voice that changes between instruction.md and the notes.' (1) instruction.md reads as a team member asking a colleague, first person and conversational: line 1 'Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day? ... so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled when someone else acts.'; line 3 'tell me why; when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who. I often move several candidates together'; line 11 'layout and names are yours. A clear desktop workspace is what matters. We don't need theme switching'. Contractions present (nobody's, don't, it's, mustn't at lines 1/11/13); sentence length varies from short ('Two things happen in it.' line 1) to long compound sentences; no bullets, numbered acceptance lists or feature matrix in instruction.md. (2) Grep of instruction.md and both note files for seamless|robust|delve|leverage|intuitive|elevate|ensure|comprehensive|streamline returned no matches: no marketing/LLM gloss. (3) Voice continuity: hireops_rules.md keeps the same owner 'we/our' voice ('These are the working rules for HireOps, our recruiting workspace. Follow them exactly. Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours; what we care about is...' lines 3-4; 'Where drafts are kept is yours.'). It is more structured (headings, role table, rule bullets) which is appropriate for a referenced rules note and is not a voice change; its bullets are not perfectly parallel boilerplate (mixed lengths, mixed sentence forms). Minor observations, not defects: hireops_rules.md section 8 'Runtime file paths' (lines 196-202, e.g. line 199 'It runs as an unprivileged user and may launch a writable copy of the submitted application') and the task-added integration.md paragraph at line 16 ('Symbolic links are supported only inside /app/node_modules...') read as platform/runtime boilerplate rather than recruiter voice, and spelling is mixed (instruction.md line 13 'honour PORT' vs hireops_rules.md line 201 'Honor' and template-controlled integration.md line 7 'honoring'). instruction.md also avoids contractions in some first-person phrases ('the note I am typing', 'A reply I have not sent'), slightly formal but still human. These do not meet the defect bar: no uniform cadence, no gloss, no robotic prose in the actual ask. Adversarial check: a stricter reader could argue the rules note's spec register is a 'voice change'; I reject that because the note explicitly frames itself as the team's working rules in the same first-person-plural voice, and the workbook row says terse/casual is good rather than requiring the notes to be chatty. No runtime evidence applies to this row; the deterministic check-instruction-content.py explicitly leaves voice to this rubric row.
suggested_fix: Optional polish only (not required for Pass): pick one spelling of honour/honor across instruction.md and hireops_rules.md, and consider phrasing hireops_rules.md section 8 in the team's voice (e.g. 'Our runner may start Node from another directory...').
